data.text:
EACEFUL RALLY  

Mapayapa ang unang araw ng mga pagtitipon o kilos-protesta sa iba't ibang bahagi ng Metro Manila nitong Nov. 16, ayon kay NCRPO spokesperson P/Maj. Hazel Asilo.  

Giit ni Asilo, nagkaroon lamang ng miscommunication sa pagitan ng INC at kapulisan sa Quirino Grandstand kahapon. Kasunod ito ng pagpapapalis ng religious group sa mga pulis na naka-deploy na malapit sa stage area.  

Humigit-kumulang 1,500 na mga pulis ang ipinakalat sa grandstand para sa seguridad.  

Naka-full alert pa rin ang pulisya sa Metro Manila sa pagpapatuloy ng mga rally.

U.S. Embassy Consular Update: Cancelation of Visa Interview Appointments on November 18
https://t.co/qiJrL9rcHk

The U.S. Embassy in the Philippines will remain closed for visa interview appointments tomorrow, November 18, due to the continued heavy traffic and road closures near the embassy, related to the rallies in the area.

For affected nonimmigrant visa applicants, please reschedule your November 18 Embassy appointment through our online appointment system by logging in to your account at https://t.co/QH9rQ23hbW. We opened additional nonimmigrant visa interview slots to provide applicants with more schedule options.

Immigrant visa applicants will receive detailed instructions through their registered email address regarding their new appointment or rescheduling options.

Applicants encountering issues or difficulties in rescheduling online should call our visa customer service center at (02) 8548 8223 for immediate assistance.  For those who have not received email notifications, please inquire through our online inquiry form at https://t.co/sSyKHZuB44.

The offsite Visa Application Center (VAC) in Paranaque City will remain open for all scheduled biometrics (photo and fingerprint collection) appointments.  This means that applicants with appointments at our offsite VAC tomorrow should proceed as scheduled.
